title: Theory, asked as a request: the math behind naive recursive Fibonacci
rubric: Treats the request as 'the theory behind this function': recursion and the call stack, then the math (T(n) = T(n-1) + T(n-2) + O(1), exponential growth ~φⁿ, each symbol explained), why fib(35) is slow, memoization named as the idea without rewriting the function, and pointers to read next.
